system: You are an ambitious AI PhD student who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: You are given the following file to work with, that trains a LSTM to detect falls. One issue with the fall detection dataset is data inbalance, with a lot of data for normal activities and very few for falls. This can lead to overfitting and poor generalization. The labels in the dataset consists of falls, alerts, and normal activities. To address this, we can use techniques such as data augmentation, class weighting, or synthetic data generation to balance the dataset.
